transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because things have gotten kind of out of hand with eating. Like, I’ll eat too much and then I end up in the bathroom making myself throw up because I’m scared I’ll gain weight. It sounds awful saying it out loud.

I work around cars all day, so I’m used to fixing things, you know, figuring out what’s wrong and getting it under control—but this, I can’t seem to fix. It’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop doing it.
Do you usually make yourself vomit only after eating a large amount in one sitting, or does it happen even after smaller meals or snacks?

Mostly after I’ve eaten too much… like when it feels like I’ve really overdone it. Then I get scared about gaining weight and I end up going to the bathroom and making myself throw up.

I mean, sometimes “too much” is hard to explain, you know? At the shop we’ll grab food fast between jobs, and then if I feel like I lost control, my head just starts going. But the vomiting is tied to that fear after eating too much. And it’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop.
Have you ever made yourself vomit even after eating just a small amount of food, not necessarily after overeating?

Not really after just a little bit, no… I mean, it’s usually when I feel like I’ve eaten too much and then I panic about gaining weight. That’s when I end up in the bathroom making myself throw up.

Sometimes my idea of “too much” is probably not normal, I don’t know. Like at work, if we’re slammed and I eat fast, it can feel like I lost control, and then my head just kind of locks onto it. But the vomiting part is mainly after I feel like I overdid it, and I’m scared I can’t stop doing that.
Do you ever feel like you’ve lost control over how much you’re eating, even if you’re not actually eating a large amount, and does that feeling lead you to make yourself vomit?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not always about the exact amount, I guess. Once I start on those nights, it’s like my hands just keep grabbing food even while I’m telling myself, “Lucy, knock it off,” and I don’t feel back in charge until it’s already done.

It’s weird, because at work I can keep track of a hundred little things—bolts, parts, what’s making a noise under the hood—but with food, in that moment, it’s like I’m not steering anymore. And then afterward I get scared and… that’s when I make myself throw up.
How often do these episodes happen where you feel out of control with eating and then make yourself throw up afterward?

For the last few months… I’d say hardly a week goes by without it happening at least once. Usually late at night, that’s when it seems to get away from me, and then I end up making myself throw up after.

Some weeks it’s more than once—several times, honestly. Especially if I’m home more because my back’s acting up. When I’m stuck around the house, I don’t know, I start wandering into the kitchen, and then it turns into that whole thing again.
Do you ever make yourself throw up even when you’re not specifically worried about gaining weight, but maybe just to feel better or stop the cycle after overeating?

I mean… sometimes I tell myself it’s just to feel better, like to stop that awful heavy feeling and make the whole thing be over. But if I’m being honest, it usually comes back to being scared I’ll gain weight after I eat too much.

That’s kind of why I’m here, I guess. I keep ending up in the bathroom making myself throw up after I overeat, and it’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop. It’s embarrassing to say out loud. I’ll be thinking about something totally normal, like whether I remembered to order parts at work, and then suddenly I’m right back in that panic.
